sources.visual_review: Full frame inspected; no pool tables appear.
sources.documented_room_direction: A Joseph Dirand room, cool and monochrome: pale grey veined marble panels on one wall, smooth grey plaster elsewhere, a herringbone oak floor, tall steel-framed windows with plain flat linen panels. A low black leather sofa with a folded throw, a pair of chrome-and-leather chairs, a charcoal wool rug, a single large black-and-white photographic print, a slim steel floor lamp switched on, a tall sculptural plant in a concrete pot, a doorway to a lit room. The cart is drawn up at the end of the sofa, on its castors, where a trolley actually lives.

sources.visual_review: Full frame inspected; no pool tables appear.
sources.documented_room_direction: A Nate Berkus coastal kitchen: whitewashed timber boarding on the walls, a long island faced in pale tongue-and-groove with a thick honed limestone top, wide bleached oak boards, a big window with plain linen showing flat sea light. Open shelving with stacked ceramics, a vintage brass pendant switched on above the island, a woven rug underfoot, a large moody sea photograph on the end wall, a fig in a woven basket, a bowl of lemons and a folded newspaper on the counter.

sources.description: An Astra home bar in a dark paneled room with brass pendants, checkerboard flooring and green velvet seating
sources.visual_review: Full frame inspected; no pool tables appear.
sources.documented_room_direction: A Ken Fulk supper club: black-and-white marble chequerboard floor, dark stained panelling to the ceiling, brass dome pendants hung low. An oxblood velvet banquette, a deep-green velvet armchair, a worn Persian rug, a salon-hung wall of framed prints, cut-glass decanters and tumblers on a marble side table, a brass library lamp switched on, a palm in a brass cachepot, a doorway to a warmly lit room. Bold and theatrical — the dark cherry bar with its corbels and chrome foot rail belongs here completely, as glamour rather than as reconstruction.

sources.description: A stocked wall-mounted Industrial Bar Shelf in a concrete and timber living room opening to greenery
sources.visual_review: Full frame inspected; no pool tables appear.
sources.documented_room_direction: A Marcio Kogan room: board-formed concrete on one wall, wide horizontal timber slats on the other, a floor of large honey-toned stone, a sliding glass wall onto a green terrace with dense planting. A long low modular sofa in warm grey, a pair of leather-and-timber lounge chairs, a woven rug, a timber credenza with ceramics and a lamp switched on, a large canvas in earth tones, books stacked on a low table, strong horizontal late light. The shelf is mounted on the concrete wall above the credenza.

matched_example.room_brief_excerpt: Cool and monochrome: pale grey veined marble panels, smooth grey plaster, a herringbone oak floor and tall steel-framed windows. A low black leather sofa, chrome-and-leather chairs, a charcoal wool rug, a photographic print and a slim floor lamp. The cart is drawn up at the end of the sofa, on its castors, where a trolley actually lives.
matched_example.prompt_constraints_excerpt: Preserve the cart’s finish, hardware, proportions and construction. Place it beside a sofa or armchair. Show the whole cart from top shelf to castors. Stock it lightly with bottles, cut-glass tumblers and an ice bucket. Use a three-quarter view at standing eye level with natural directional daylight.
